commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /root/.ssh
printf '%s\n' '10.100.5.10 ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIJyzrc1HxAi+qLJc+731vdNmSADcRNVN9LpOvCkRFA0j' > /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
chmod 0600 /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1 <<'ANTRIEB_BACKUP_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
export PATH
SOURCE=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_HOST=10.100.5.10
DEST_USER=inventorybackup
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
KEY=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519
KNOWN_HOSTS=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
DATE=$(date +%F)
NAME=inventory-${DATE}.tar.gz
LOCAL_TMP=/var/tmp/${NAME}.$$.tmp
REMOTE_TMP=${DEST_DIR}/.${NAME}.$$.part
SSH_OPTS="-i ${KEY} -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=${KNOWN_HOSTS} -o ConnectTimeout=15"
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$LOCAL_TMP"
    ssh $SSH_OPTS "${DEST_USER}@${DEST_HOST}" "rm -f '${REMOTE_TMP}'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
exec 9>/run/inventory-backup.lock
if ! flock -n 9; then
    logger -t inventory-backup 'another backup run is active'
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -d "$SOURCE" ]; then
    logger -t inventory-backup "source directory missing: $SOURCE"
    exit 1
fi
tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$LOCAL_TMP" data
tar -tzf "$LOCAL_TMP" >/dev/null
ssh $SSH_OPTS "${DEST_USER}@${DEST_HOST}" "umask 077; cat > '${REMOTE_TMP}'" < "$LOCAL_TMP"
ssh $SSH_OPTS "${DEST_USER}@${DEST_HOST}" "set -eu; test -s '${REMOTE_TMP}'; mv -f '${REMOTE_TMP}' '${DEST_DIR}/${NAME}'; find '${DEST_DIR}' -daystart -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
logger -t inventory-backup "completed ${NAME}"
ANTRIEB_BACKUP_SCRIPT
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1
cat > /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_CRON'
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
30 1 * * * root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1
ANTRIEB_CRON
chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1 /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'SCRIPT='; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1
printf 'CRON='; cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
printf 'HOST_PIN='; cat /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
printf 'SYNTAX='; sh -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup-to-node1 && printf 'ok\n'
printf 'CROND='; systemctl is-active crond
